learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic building blocks of PLC systems. Identifies basic components such as input/output modules, processor, and memory unit.
Understand the role of PLC in industrial automation. Evaluate why and how PLC is used in industry and its advantages.
Distinguish between different PLC models and programming languages. Have knowledge of languages such as Ladder Diagram (LD), Function Block Diagram (FBD), Structured Text (ST), etc.
Programs basic logic circuits in a PLC environment. Develops applications using basic commands such as AND, OR, NOT, timer, and counter.
It connects PLCs to industrial equipment such as sensors, relays, and motors. It interacts with peripheral elements connected to the PLC in real hardware or simulation environments.
Analyzes PLC programs, detects and corrects errors. Examines the logical flow of a created program and solves problems.

syllabus_topics: Application development with Factory IO and TIA Portal
A design with sensor, Use of pusher system on driver side.
Factory IO and TIA Portal Sensor and Actuator Application
